INSERT INTO document_segments
    (document_id, seq_no, heading, segment_text, char_start, char_end, char_count)
SELECT
    $1::BIGINT,
    (s->>'seq_no')::INTEGER,
    s->>'heading',
    s->>'segment_text',
    (s->>'char_start')::INTEGER,
    (s->>'char_end')::INTEGER,
    (s->>'char_count')::INTEGER
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::JSONB) AS s
ON CONFLICT (document_id, seq_no) DO UPDATE SET
    heading      = EXCLUDED.heading,
    segment_text = EXCLUDED.segment_text,
    char_start   = EXCLUDED.char_start,
    char_end     = EXCLUDED.char_end,
    char_count   = EXCLUDED.char_count
RETURNING id;

UPDATE documents
SET full_text       = $2,
    text_char_count = $3::INTEGER,
    segment_count   = $4::INTEGER,
    page_count      = $5::INTEGER,
    extracted_at    = NOW(),
    status          = 'extracted'
WHERE id = $1::BIGINT
RETURNING id, segment_count, text_char_count, status;
